name: Vaya Mountain Lodge St. Zeno
beschreibung: The Vaya Mountain Lodge St. Zeno is located in the center of Serfaus, just a few minutes' walk from the cable car. The house combines modern alpine-designed spaces with a quiet atmosphere that invites relaxation. Guests can expect comfortably furnished rooms, a breakfast offering, and a wellness area with sauna and relaxation zone. Access to the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski area is convenient on foot or by lift.
